While Applying - please mention in subjectline - Position and Project – Sumitomo and Location as Abu Dhabi

The role ensures that EPC contractor works are executed in accordance with project specifications, industry standards, quality requirements, and contractual obligations.
q: Gas Turbines and Combined Cycle Power Plants (CCPP).
Water Treatment and Balance of Plant (BOP) Systems.
Familiarity with ASME, API, ASTM and relevant international standards.
Ability to review engineering drawings and specifications.
Understanding of EPC documentation and quality systems.
Effective communication in an international project environment.
Professional Engineering registration/certification is an advantage.

Minimum 10-15 years of relevant experience in power generation, EPC, Owner's Engineer, or utility projects.
Proven experience on Combined Cycle Power Plants (CCPP), Thermal Power Plants, IPPs, or large industrial projects.
Experience supervising construction, installation, and commissioning activities.

r: Review and monitor mechanical engineering deliverables, drawings, calculations, specifications, and technical submittals.
